title: Spider-Girl #10 Marvel 1999 Spectacular Spider-Man Team-Up DeFalco Frenz MC2
condition_description: Bright, clean covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Spider-Girl #10 (July 1999), Marvel Comics MC2 - "At last! The team-up you demanded!" Spider-Girl (May Parker) joins forces with the Spectacular Spider-Man. Written by Tom DeFalco, art by Ron Frenz and Pat Olliffe. Direct edition, $1.99 cover price.

Back cover: Milky Way "milk it" ad.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
